tools.name: audio_status
tools.description: Report which audio capabilities are wired up right now (listen, transcribe, speak, sing, convert, play). Call it before promising any audio output when you are unsure.

summary.zh: 报告语音能力此刻的接入状态。
summary.en: Reports which audio capabilities are wired up right now.

tools.name: audio_play
tools.description: Play an audio file now (a local path, or a log:/mem: blob handle); later requests queue up behind it. Returns the queue id and position — playback finishes in the background, so do not wait for it.

path.description: Absolute path to the audio file; give this or handle.

handle.description: A log:/mem: blob handle for the audio; give this or path.

volume.description: Volume for this item; defaults to the configured volume.

balance.description: Left/right balance for this item: -100 hard left, 0 center, 100 hard right. Defaults to the configured balance.

summary.zh: 播放一个音频文件，后面的排队。
summary.en: Plays an audio file; later requests queue up.

tools.name: audio_open
tools.description: Open an audio file in the computer's default player application, where the person can pause, seek and replay it themselves. Accepts a local path or a log:/mem: blob handle. This does not use the playback queue.

path.description: Absolute path to the audio file; give this or handle.

handle.description: A log:/mem: blob handle for the audio; give this or path.

summary.zh: 用系统默认播放器打开一个音频文件。
summary.en: Opens an audio file in the system default player.

tools.name: audio_say
tools.description: Say a line with the configured speech engine and play it through the audio queue. Returns at once: synthesis and playback run in the background, and only a failure comes back as an audio.failed event. With silent=true it synthesizes in the background without playback and the file path comes back as an audio.say_done event.

voice.description: Optional voice for this line; empty uses the configured one.

balance.description: Left/right balance when this line is played: -100 hard left, 0 center, 100 hard right. Defaults to the configured balance.

summary.zh: 按当前引擎合成一句话并播放。
summary.en: Synthesizes a line with the current engine and plays it.

tools.name: audio_convert
tools.description: Convert an audio file (a local path, or a log:/mem: blob handle) into the configured RVC voice and play the result through the audio queue. Returns at once: conversion runs in the background, the result lands in the speech records, and only a failure comes back as an audio.failed event.

path.description: Absolute path to the audio file to convert; give this or handle.

handle.description: A log:/mem: blob handle for the audio; give this or path.

voice.description: Optional voice file name (the .pth in the voice folder); empty uses the configured one.

silent.description: Convert only; do not play. The path and an audio blob handle come back as an audio.convert_done event.

summary.zh: 把一段音频换成当前变声音色，转完自动播放。
summary.en: Converts an audio file into the configured voice and plays it.

tools.name: audio_sing
tools.description: Sing the given lyrics with the configured DiffSinger voicebank and play the song through the audio queue. Returns at once: synthesis runs in the background, the result lands in the speech records, and only a failure comes back as an audio.failed event.

lyrics.description: Lyrics to sing; Chinese characters. Punctuation only splits phrases.

silent.description: Sing only; do not play. The path and an audio blob handle come back as an audio.sing_done event.

summary.zh: 用 DiffSinger 把歌词唱出来并播放。
summary.en: Sings lyrics with DiffSinger and plays the song.

tools.name: audio_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file (a local path, or a log:/mem: blob handle) with the configured speech-to-text engine. Returns at once: transcription runs in the background, the text lands in the transcript records and comes back as an audio.transcribed event; a failure comes back as audio.failed.

path.description: Absolute path to the audio file; give this or handle.

handle.description: A log:/mem: blob handle for the audio; give this or path.

summary.zh: 转写一个音频文件，完成后以事件带回文字。
summary.en: Transcribes an audio file in the background; the text arrives as an event.

tools.name: audio_queue
tools.description: Inspect or change the playback queue: list it, skip the current item, remove one queued item by id, or stop and clear everything.

id.description: Queue id to remove (only for act=remove).

summary.en: Inspect or change the playback queue.

tools.name: audio_separate
tools.description: Separate a local song into vocals and accompaniment with the installed Demucs model. Returns a job id immediately; completion arrives as audio.separated with both file paths, failure as audio.failed. Setup is obtained by the user in Music > Separate.

summary.zh: 把歌曲分成人声和伴奏。
summary.en: Separate a song into vocals and accompaniment.

tools.name: audio_mix
tools.description: Mix 1–16 local audio tracks into a WAV with per-track volume and start delay. Returns a job id immediately; completion arrives as audio.mixed with the file path, failure as audio.failed. Does not play automatically.

summary.zh: 按音量和时间偏移混合多条音轨。
summary.en: Mix tracks with individual levels and start offsets.

tools.name: audio_abc_music_score
tools.description: Validate, save, revise or read ABC scores and drafts. Saved scores appear as sheet music in the Scores panel. Before editing, get the current score and save with expectedRevision. A rejected score is kept as a draft; list drafts with action=drafts and fetch one with action=draft. Use action=revise with a block marker (% block: A ... % end: A) to replace only one section; block names are listed when a block is missing. backing selects whether quoted chords only label the score (off), drive abcjs backing (abcjs), or drive the full groove band (band). groove, energy and sections are the band settings. Audio rendering is separate. Validation and saving work without installed SoundFonts.

abc.description: For check/save: one complete ABC tune with X/M/L/K headers; T/Q recommended. For action=revise: only the new body of the named block. Use V: for independent voices and [CEG] for chords. Define motifs with comment lines "% motif name: ..."; the motif body is ordinary ABC music (note lengths and z rests, not a compose slot grid). Write @name, @name+1 or @name-1 alone in a bar to reuse and transpose them by scale steps. Wrap sections between "% block: A" and "% end: A" to revise one section without resending the score. Quoted chord names are labels and drive accompaniment only when backing is abcjs or band; the receipt checks long and downbeat notes against them.

block.description: For action=revise: the name between "% block: name" and "% end: name".

instrument.description: Preset ID from audio_abc_music_control action=instruments. Selects the SoundFont and default MIDI patch. Explicit ABC %%MIDI program overrides individual voices within that SoundFont.

backing.description: off: quoted chord names are labels only. abcjs: a simple bass/chord backing from abcjs. band: the full groove band (comp, bass, drums, fills) arranged from the quoted chord names. The written ABC is unchanged; the backing only exists in the rendered MIDI/WAV.

groove.description: Groove for backing=band: pop, rock, ballad, bossa, samba, swing, waltz, funk, lofi, dance, ambient, or none. Meter-specific grooves must fit the tune.

energy.description: Band energy for backing=band: 1 is the sparsest version of the groove, 5 the busiest.

sections.description: Optional per-section overrides for backing=band. Bars are 1-based performance bars (a pickup counts as bar 1). A section without groove or energy inherits the top-level value.

stopBars.description: Absolute 1-based performance bars in this section where the band plays one hit on beat 1 and then rests; the written ABC continues.

summary.zh: 检查、保存与读取 ABC 曲谱、版本和草稿。
summary.en: Validate, save and read ABC scores and drafts.

tools.name: audio_abc_music_play
tools.description: Render a WAV in the background using an installed SoundFont. Supply exactly one of score or abc. Direct ABC is saved after rendering succeeds. The receipt carries measured facts: length, voices, ranges, notes outside an instrument range, repeated bars, rhythm variety, steps and leaps, chromatic notes outside a quoted chord, and the rendered level and peak. backing=band arranges the full comp, bass and drum band from the quoted chords with the selected groove and energy; backing=abcjs asks abcjs for a simple bass/chord backing; off keeps quoted chords as labels. Works retain the ABC snapshot and MIDI. return attaches audio to the tool receipt; event emits audio.abc_played. Playback and sending use other tools. Ask the user to obtain or import a SoundFont in Instruments when none is installed.

abc.description: For check/save: one complete ABC tune with X/M/L/K headers; T/Q recommended. For action=revise: only the new body of the named block. Use V: for independent voices and [CEG] for chords. Define motifs with comment lines "% motif name: ..."; the motif body is ordinary ABC music (note lengths and z rests, not a compose slot grid). Write @name, @name+1 or @name-1 alone in a bar to reuse and transpose them by scale steps. Wrap sections between "% block: A" and "% end: A" to revise one section without resending the score. Quoted chord names are labels and drive accompaniment only when backing is abcjs or band; the receipt checks long and downbeat notes against them.

instrument.description: Preset ID from audio_abc_music_control action=instruments. Selects the SoundFont and default MIDI patch. Explicit ABC %%MIDI program overrides individual voices within that SoundFont.

backing.description: off: quoted chord names are labels only. abcjs: a simple bass/chord backing from abcjs. band: the full groove band (comp, bass, drums, fills) arranged from the quoted chord names. The written ABC is unchanged; the backing only exists in the rendered MIDI/WAV.

groove.description: Groove for backing=band: pop, rock, ballad, bossa, samba, swing, waltz, funk, lofi, dance, ambient, or none. Meter-specific grooves must fit the tune.

energy.description: Band energy for backing=band: 1 is the sparsest version of the groove, 5 the busiest.

sections.description: Optional per-section overrides for backing=band. Bars are 1-based performance bars (a pickup counts as bar 1). A section without groove or energy inherits the top-level value.

stopBars.description: Absolute 1-based performance bars in this section where the band plays one hit on beat 1 and then rests; the written ABC continues.

summary.zh: 把 ABC 曲谱渲染为采样音源 WAV，回执带测量结果，并保存作品。
summary.en: Render ABC to sampled audio, retain a score snapshot and report measured facts.

tools.name: audio_abc_music_control
tools.description: Read ABC Music status, list installed SoundFont presets, or set the default instrument, backing mode, band groove, band energy and audio delivery. Use instruments before choosing a preset ID. SoundFonts are obtained or imported by the user in the Instruments panel.

instrument.description: Preset ID from audio_abc_music_control action=instruments. Selects the SoundFont and default MIDI patch. Explicit ABC %%MIDI program overrides individual voices within that SoundFont.

backing.description: off: quoted chord names are labels only. abcjs: a simple bass/chord backing from abcjs. band: the full groove band (comp, bass, drums, fills) arranged from the quoted chord names. The written ABC is unchanged; the backing only exists in the rendered MIDI/WAV.

groove.description: Groove for backing=band: pop, rock, ballad, bossa, samba, swing, waltz, funk, lofi, dance, ambient, or none. Meter-specific grooves must fit the tune.

energy.description: Band energy for backing=band: 1 is the sparsest version of the groove, 5 the busiest.

summary.zh: 列出音源预设、查看状态或设置乐器、伴奏与交付方式。
summary.en: List SoundFont presets, read status or configure instruments, backing and delivery.

description.zh: 从某一路声音里切出一块并（可自动）转成文字，正文存进转写记录；事件默认只归档，打开「通知 Coo」时按内核 debounce 投递，几句会在同一次唤醒里一起给到模型。
description.en: A chunk was cut from one listening lane and transcribed (when enabled); the text goes to the transcript records. Archived by default; with notify on the event is pushed with trigger=debounce, so the core batches close sentences into one wake-up.

description.zh: silent 合成完成，带回本地路径与音频附件句柄。
description.en: A silent audio_say finished; it carries the local path and the audio as a blob attachment.

description.zh: 后台说话、转写、变声、唱歌、分离或混音失败，正文包含工具名、任务编号与失败原因。
description.en: A background speech, transcription, conversion, singing, separation, or mixing task failed; the text includes the tool name, job id, and error.

description.zh: 后台转写完成，带回文字。
description.en: A background transcription finished; it carries the text.

description.zh: silent 变声完成，带回本地路径与音频附件句柄。
description.en: A silent audio_convert finished; it carries the local path and the audio as a blob attachment.

description.zh: silent 唱歌完成，带回本地路径与音频附件句柄。
description.en: A silent audio_sing finished; it carries the local path and the audio as a blob attachment.

description.zh: 歌曲分离完成，带回人声与伴奏路径。
description.en: Song separation finished with paths to vocals and accompaniment.

description.zh: 混音完成，带回 WAV 路径。
description.en: Mixing finished with the WAV file path.

description.zh: ABC 演奏完成：WAV 附件、曲谱版本与文件路径。

changelog.0.1.8: - 修复 ffmpeg 下载 404：BtbN 的 autobuild 标签只保留最近几天，之前钉死的 `autobuild-2026-11-01-12-49` 已被上游清理。Windows/Linux 改用 `latest` 标签下名字固定的资产，下载前从同一 release 的 `checksums.sha256` 现取 SHA-256；macOS 仍钉版本与哈希。
changelog.0.1.7:
- 音乐页改为一级页签：分离、混音、作曲、编曲、音源、记录。原「乐谱」更名「作曲」，原「乐器」更名「音源」；「作品」并入「记录」，与分离/混音作品同页、同一卡片格式。
- 作曲/编曲增加 band 编曲：11 种律动、energy 1–5、分段覆盖、停拍、过门、swing、人性化、每角色混音；引号和弦驱动伴奏，写谱不变。
- 渲染回执带测量事实（小节、声部音域、超域、重复/节奏、级进/跳进、和弦冲突音、RMS/峰值）；和弦冲突音只报调外冲突，调内 9/11/13 度张力不误报。
- 检查/渲染失败保留 ABC 草稿，`audio_abc_music_score` 支持 `drafts` / `draft`。
- 写谱支持动机宏（`% motif 名字: ...`、`@名字+1`）和命名块局部修订（`% block: A` … `% end: A`，`action=revise`）。
- 作曲/编曲增加「导出 MIDI」，按当前谱/编曲设置即时生成，不落 MIDI 文件。作品记录只保存 WAV，不再保存谱面快照、MIDI/ABC 文件。
- 新增 `audio_open`：用系统默认播放器打开音频文件，不走播放队列。
changelog.0.1.6: - 修复 Linux x64 下安装卡在 `onnxruntime-node` 的 NuGet 302 报错，以及 Windows 下与 `sherpa-onnx-node` 同进程共存时的 `onnxruntime.dll` 冲突：`onnxruntime-node` 钉在 `1.17.0`（自带 6 个平台/架构的 CPU 预编译二进制且无 `postinstall` 脚本，不再请求 `api.nuget.org` 拉取 CUDA 12 原生包，解包体积从 307 MB 降到 101 MB）；`loadOnnxRuntime()` 先加载 `sherpa-onnx-node`，让两者在 Windows 下共用 1.28.2 的 `onnxruntime.dll`。
changelog.0.1.5:
- 参考音频导入支持任意格式：WAV 校验改成看 RIFF/WAVE 头（改扩展名的假 WAV 会被挡下），其他格式（mp3/flac/m4a/ogg 等）交给 ffmpeg 转成 16 kHz 单声道 WAV；没装 ffmpeg 时提示先装或自行转换。说话页的选择器与拖拽文案同步放宽。
- 云端合成写分阶段日志：按 request / response / download / failed 回报目标 host、字数与各阶段耗时，卡住时能看出停在哪一段；失败时区分自己的超时与队列取消。
- 混音输出从 24 bit 改为 16 bit PCM，避免部分客户端拒收。
changelog.0.1.4: - FireRed 监听不再吃满 CPU：VAD 与 AED 的 ONNX 会话改为单线程、顺序执行并关闭空闲自旋。onnxruntime 默认按物理核开线程池、线程空闲时自旋等活，监听有声音时几十个核都在空转（64 线程机器上实测 30.8 核 → 0.04 核），单帧延迟反而略降；AED 60 秒块约 0.4 秒，不受影响。
changelog.0.1.3:
- 说话改为流式：Edge、本机 GPT-SoVITS 与 OpenAI 兼容接口边合成边交给 ffmpeg 解码播放，不再等整句；播放队列在当前句开播时预取下一条，连续说话不再等合成。缺 ffmpeg 或原生输出时自动退回收齐再播；流式 WAV 落盘前补长度，记录能读出准确时长。
- Edge 连接按音色复用，同一音色连说不再每次重连；新建连接约 1 秒的代价只付一次，之后首音约 0.3 秒。
- 说话首块 PCM 到达时写一条「说话首音」日志（`worlds.audio`），带播放等待与合成耗时。
changelog.0.1.2: - 播放支持左右平衡：新增 `worlds.audio.balance`（-100 全左 … 100 全右，0 居中）和播放页滑杆；`audio_play`、`audio_say` 可按条或按句指定 `balance`。原生 PCM 输出按左右声道衰减；Windows 的 PowerShell 兜底同步支持，Linux 的 ffplay 兜底使用 pan 滤镜；macOS 的 afplay 没有左右调节，退回它时该参数不生效。
changelog.0.1.1: - 市场卡片不再标「仅 Windows」：去掉继承自声音扩展的 `os` 限制，三个平台的安装不再被标记限制。
changelog.0.1.0:
- 从 `cortico-world-voice` 分出的跨平台版本，包名 `@aqualcross/cortico-world-audio`。
- 按应用监听：Windows / Linux 提供系统声音、麦克风与按应用三路；macOS 只有麦克风，界面隐藏不可用来源。
- 「说话」默认引擎为 Edge 朗读（免密钥、免安装，需要联网），默认音色 `zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural`；合成结果是 mp3，附件类型与文件名跟随实际格式。
- 跨平台适配：`loopback-capture` 改为可选依赖，macOS 不再因它安装失败；系统声音在 Windows 走 WASAPI、Linux 走 PipeWire，macOS 只提供麦克风；播放兜底按平台（Windows PowerShell、macOS afplay、Linux ffplay）；结束进程按平台；ffmpeg 与 uv 三个平台都可在依赖页点击下载（Windows/Linux 用 BtbN，macOS 用 evermeet / osxexperts）；GPT-SoVITS 模型链接改用 symlink；桌面字幕仅 Windows；macOS 不显示系统声音与按应用来源；POSIX 卸载会先清掉占用目录的残留进程。
- uv/ffmpeg 不再猜安装目录：uv 只认配置与 PATH 裸名，ffmpeg 从 PATH 解析真实路径并写回配置。
- 移除 audio_listen 工具：监听只能从「听」页开启，避免模型主动开启监听被市场标记为读取隐私。
- 本地 GPT-SoVITS / RVC / DiffSinger 只在 Windows 上验证过；macOS 与 Linux 为尽力支持。
